title: Bakken Bears clinch Ligaen title
description: Svendborg - Bakken 77-81 Bakken Bears celebrated Ligaen title. They edged Svendborg on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. The Bears therefore claimed the sixth straight Ligaen trophy. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 24-17. But Svendborg won second period 17-12. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Worth to mention a great performance of American center Travis Taylor (203-1990, college: Xavier, agency: Slash Sports) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 19 points and 11 rebounds. The other American import point guard Marvelle Harris (196-1993, college: Fresno St., agency: Slash Sports) contributed with 22 points for the winners.
